Variants.Content: Noble cavalry relies on estates, horses and followers. Pass guards require valley food; prolonged campaigning strains both defended estates and fighters’ households.

Armenian noble cavalry relies on estates, horses and followers. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Pass guards require continued valley grain.

Pass guards require continued valley grain. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Armenian noble cavalry relies on estates, horses and followers.
